integrity: The scalar connected forcing number \(Z_c(W_n)=3\) is treated as prior work. The claimed contribution is the complete structural classification and all-cardinality enumerator. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to wheels \(W_n=K_1\vee C_n\) with rim order \(n\ge4\). Exhaustive computation checks only \(4\le n\le11\); the all-orders conclusion rests on the proof. A poorly indexed prior wheel enumeration remains a residual literature risk.
title: Connected-forcing polynomial of wheel graphs
